headline: Consensus to have administration review East Veterans’ Elementary School as a meeting site; DPW tickets, FY25 audit, and special education also discussed.
summary: The subcommittee discussed DPW tickets, the FY25 end-of-year report audit, special education, budget transfers, and technical issues in the GHS Library. The superintendent presented three alternative meeting locations. The subcommittee agreed that the administration should review East Veterans’ Elementary School.
decisions: By consensus, the subcommittee asked the administration to review holding meetings at East Veterans’ Elementary School.

decision_evidence.quote: It was the consensus of the subcommittee that the administration review the option of holding meetings at the East Veterans’ Elementary School, due to its better accessibility, technology setup, and ADA compliance.
